description: Remote tunnel configuration management via Cloudflare API v4

requirements.title: API token management
requirements.description: Store Cloudflare API token securely (environment variable or encrypted file). Token requires 'Cloudflare Tunnel:Edit' permission scope.

requirements.title: Read current tunnel configuration
requirements.description: GET /accounts/{id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations to fetch current ingress rules. Used for seeding the route manifest and detecting drift.

requirements.title: Push route manifest to tunnel config
requirements.description: PUT /accounts/{id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id}/configurations to update ingress rules from the route manifest. Full replacement (read-modify-write pattern). Always includes catch-all 404 rule as last entry.

requirements.title: Hot-reload verification
requirements.description: After pushing config via API, verify cloudflared picks up changes by checking cloudflared_config_local_config_pushes metric increment. Log success/failure.

requirements.title: Tunnel status query
requirements.description: GET /accounts/{id}/cfd_tunnel/{tunnel_id} to fetch tunnel status and connection info. Display tunnel name, status, created date, and connected edge locations.

requirements.title: Mode switching
requirements.description: tunnel-manager config mode [local|remote] switches management mode. When switching to remote: validate API token, read current local config, push to API. When switching to local: read current API config, write to config.yml.
